newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to release 800 billion won to banks.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to release 800 billion won to banks.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea (BOK) plans to release 800 billion won to the banking system on Wednesday through repurchase agreements (Repo) maturing next Monday, a BOK official said.
The official said the plan was aimed at helping ease an expected liquidity shortage in the wake of tax payments valued at about 2.5 trillion won.
Repo is one of the central bank's main tools to control money in circulation.
He said the money released would also help banks meet the twice-a-month deadline due next Monday for the central bank's review of won reserve requirement levels.
